quarterly_data.quarter: Prysmian press release: Prysmian raises guidance after its best quarter yet (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Prysmian (release): Q2 2026 revenues were EUR 6,021 million with +9.4% organic growth (Digital Solutions +18.0%, Power Grid +13.0%, Transmission +14.3%, Industrial & Construction +9.1%, Specialties -2.4%); adjusted EBITDA rose 20.7% to EUR 730 million at a 15.4% margin, its strongest quarter ever; Digital Solutions adjusted EBITDA almost doubled to EUR 122 million at a 23.8% margin thanks to optical cables and Channell; Industrial & Construction growth was driven by data-center demand in North America; H1 2026 revenues EUR 11,239 million (+7.2% organic) and adjusted EBITDA EUR 1,331 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 adjusted EBITDA EUR 730 million; Digital Solutions margin 23.8%

quarterly_data.quarter: Prysmian press release: Prysmian raises guidance after its best quarter yet (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Prysmian (release): FY2026 guidance raised to adjusted EBITDA of EUR 2,800-EUR 2,900 million (previously EUR 2,625-EUR 2,775 million) and free cash flow of EUR 1,650-EUR 1,750 million (previously EUR 1,300-EUR 1,400 million); a new Capital Markets Day will be held within 1H27, and CEO Massimo Battaini says Prysmian is well placed to achieve its 2028 targets ahead of schedule.

quarterly_data.quarter: Prysmian press release: Prysmian raises guidance after its best quarter yet (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CEO Massimo Battaini (release): Prysmian cements its position as the front-running cable player for data centers after the transformative Molex deal and a capacity increase in Digital Solutions, with major deals to enter the 'inside' data center space complementing its connectivity and long-haul digital connection strengths.

quarterly_data.quarter: Prysmian press release: Prysmian raises guidance after its best quarter yet (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Prysmian (release): net financial debt fell to EUR 4,079 million at June 30, 2026, with LTM free cash flow of EUR 978 million and EUR 703 million of net capital expenditure; proceeds of EUR 580 million came from the sale of the YOFC stake and other disposals.
quarterly_data.figure: net financial debt EUR 4,079 million; net capex EUR 703 million (LTM)
